query: SELECT id, brainName, LEFT(icpBuyingSignals, 500) as buyingSignals, LEFT(urgencyTriggers, 500) as urgencyTriggers, LEFT(icpPainPoints, 500) as painPoints, LEFT(coreCapabilities, 500) as capabilities FROM offering_brain WHERE isActive = 1 LIMIT 1;
